app.title: HiveAR
app.stillUpdating: Recorded. The screen is still catching up; it will refresh shortly.
error.network: The server could not be reached.
status.incompatible: This release cannot run against the database as it now stands. Nothing can be changed from here.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.explanation: This draft has no user accounts yet. It is protected by a single development key, set when the server was started.
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Place one to begin.
account.buckets: What the balance is made of
account.buckets.order: Payments are applied in this order unless directed otherwise.
dispute.title: Record a dispute on this account?
dispute.body: Once an account is disputed, a payment is applied to it only where the consumer directs it there. This is recorded permanently in the account's history.
payments.empty: No payments have been applied to this account.
payment.title: Take a payment
payment.amount.invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero, with at most {digits} decimal places.
payment.apply.buckets: As the payer directs, by bucket
payment.buckets.exceed: The bucket amounts add up to more than the amount received.
payment.buckets.none: Enter an amount for at least one bucket.
payment.buckets.remainder: {amount} of this payment is not directed to a bucket and will be held unapplied.
payment.disputed.notice: This account is disputed. A payment is applied to it only where the consumer directs it there.
payment.disputed.directed: The consumer directed this payment to this account
payment.disputed.held: Without that direction the whole payment will be held unapplied.
multi.title: Take one payment across {count} accounts
multi.method: How to share what the consumer did not direct
multi.directed.exceed: The directed amounts add up to more than the amount received.
multi.disputed: Disputed: receives only what the consumer directs to it.
multi.currency: These accounts are not all in one currency, so one payment cannot cover them.
receipt.title: Payment recorded
receipt.unapplied.note: This money was not applied to any account. It stays on the payment.
place.title: Place an account
place.balances.none: Enter an opening balance for at least one bucket.
place.noBuckets: No balance buckets are defined on this installation, so an account cannot be placed. Buckets come from a debt-type module.
place.currency.invalid: Three capital letters, such as USD.
app.error: Something went wrong on this page. Reload to continue. Nothing you had already recorded is lost.
app.recordedEarlier: The server had already recorded this. Here is what it recorded.
status.preview: This is the preview port. It shows release {release}, which is not the one serving users. Nothing can be changed from here.
status.newBuild: This page was loaded from a different build than the one now answering. Reload to use it.
status.stalled: Screens are not updating: a read model has stopped ({names}). Changes are still being recorded, but what is shown may be out of date. Tell an administrator.
account.refreshFailed: This page could not be refreshed, so it may be out of date.
payments.details.label: Details of the {amount} payment received {date}
payment.disputed.required: Tick the box to confirm the consumer directed this payment to this account, or it cannot be applied by bucket.
payment.disputed.buckets: Entering bucket amounts records that the consumer directed this money to this account.
receipt.nothingApplied: None of this payment was applied to an account. All of it is held unapplied.
receipt.reverse.explain: Reversing backs the whole payment out of every account above, exactly as it was applied. The original payment stays in the history.
place.currency.unavailable: The list of currencies could not be loaded.
nav.label: Sections
allPayments.title: Payments
allPayments.explain: Every payment received, newest first. Money that was not applied to an account is held on the payment and can be found here.
allPayments.emptyHeld: No payment is holding unapplied money.
refusal.account_not_found: One of these accounts could not be found.
refusal.key_reused: A different record was already saved from this form. Close it and start again.
refusal.bucket_not_registered: One of these buckets is not defined on this installation.
refusal.direction_conflict: An account can take a directed amount or bucket amounts, not both.
refusal.direction_off_payment: An amount was directed to an account that is not part of this payment.
refusal.account_not_active: One of these accounts is not active.
refusal.currency_mismatch: One of these accounts is held in a different currency from the payment.
refusal.bucket_cannot_take: A bucket was given more than it owes. The balances may have changed; close this and look again.
refusal.directed_exceeds_amount: The directed amounts add up to more than the payment.
refusal.payment_not_found: This payment could not be found.
refusal.payment_not_reversible: This payment has already been reversed.
refusal.dispute_needs_direction: This account is disputed. Bucket amounts can be applied to it only where the consumer directed them.
refusal.preview_read_only: This is the preview port. Nothing can be changed from here.
refusal.conflict: Someone else changed this at the same moment. Try again.
refusal.incompatible_schema: This release cannot change anything, because the database has moved past it.
status.built: This page was built for release {release}.
refusal.not_found: That could not be found. It may not exist, or the screens may still be catching up.
refusal.search_invalid: That search contains a character that cannot be searched for.
refusal.unknown_reason_code: The server could not record a reason for this change. Tell an administrator.
announce.unknown: No answer came back. Checking whether it was recorded.
